ai_summary: Aarvi Encon Limited announced a Board of Directors meeting for November 4, 2026, to approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with an associated insider trading window closure from October 1 to November 6, 2026. A notable red flag is the company's apparent non-compliance with SEBI regulations, as this intimation was provided on the same day as the scheduled meeting, failing to meet the mandatory minimum two working days' prior notice requirement for board meetings considering financial results.
